_about: extControl datagrams and the layout grid worked out by hand from the Nanoleaf OpenAPI documentation (External Control, streaming protocol versions 1 and 2) and docs/hardware/nanoleaf.md. Transition time is 0 (jump to the colour), W is 0.

layout.derivation: Canvas squares (shapeType 2) centred at (50,50), (150,50), (150,150), plus a Shapes Controller (12) and a Power Supply (5), which carry no LEDs and are left out. Nearest panels are 100 units apart -> unit 100 / 2 = 50. Cells: x = (x - 50) / 50, y = (150 - y) / 50 (layout y points up, the canvas down) -> (0,2), (2,2), (2,0); size 3 x 3.

v1.derivation: nPanels 2 = 02; panel 12 = 0C, nFrames 01, FF 00 00, W 00, transition 00; panel 200 = C8, 01, 00 80 FF, 00, 00. To the streamControlIpAddr:streamControlPort of the extControl reply.
